## What this is

Wooden Man Weather is a Marquette-focused weather dashboard and Monday work-week briefing. The dashboard shows National Weather Service forecasts, active alerts, and rolling twelve-month comparisons of temperature, precipitation, and snowfall against NOAA 1991–2020 normals for station [USW00094850](https://www.weather.gov/mqt/local_climate_information).

## How it updates

The site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) and published to GitHub Pages. A GitHub Actions workflow renders the project on pushes to `main` and on a daily schedule so forecasts and climate caches stay current without a Shiny server.

## Attribution

Forecast and alert data: [National Weather Service](https://www.weather.gov/). Historical observations and normals: [NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/). This is an independent project and is not endorsed by NOAA or the NWS.
